02-welcome-pack.verdict: The e4 centred card is a real step toward the guide, but it still has an explaining paragraph, rarity-coloured names, a heavy 'Take the pack' button and a bare close button with no X; the e1 full-screen slab is the exact pattern the guide deletes.

03-hub-floor.verdict: The hub floor is a readable playground but not a polished AAA screen: station labels are oversized and equal-weight, there is no clear primary action, and the corner text, test-build joke caption and cramped footer ignore the style guide.

04-stash-terminal.verdict: This is a dense full-screen slab with no clear focal point, tiny unreadable type, explaining sentences stacked in four places, and a tooltip-like toast sitting over the modal, so it ignores most of the style guide.

05-sector-page.verdict: A full-bleed form slab with a huge empty brown banner, an unreadable tiny map, wrapped steppers and explanatory sentences everywhere, so it ignores the modal, header, type-scale and close-button rules and looks like a debug panel, not a shippable pre-raid screen.

06-terms.verdict: A tidy dark modal that obeys the palette, but every element sits at the same grey weight, the type is far below the 16/20px floor, and an explaining paragraph plus a duplicate toast clutter it, so it reads as a generic template and not a polished game screen.

07-party-coop.verdict: The party card is a dark centred modal that follows the guide's panel and sentence-case rules, but it is a wall of small explaining text with a centred title, no hero or primary action, a bottom-text Close button and a misplaced Join button, so it reads as a debug dialog rather than a polished menu.

08-shop.verdict: The dark tile grid and amber Buy button are a decent start, but the screen is a full-bleed slab with half its area empty, tiny sub-16px text, a stacked currency block, a bottom-left toast-like quip, a bottom-left Close instead of top-right X, and a '$' price that breaks the style guide.

09-craft.verdict: The craft grid is clean and readable, but the screen is a top-heavy template with a dead lower half, a cream detail card that clashes with the dark UI, and a header that collides and shows redundant currency.

10-hire.verdict: A tidy but generic grid, undermined by a loud red glitch banner that outranks everything, a washed-out cream detail panel with a disabled-looking Hire button, and duplicated currency and price data.

11-wirt-gambler.verdict: A tidy but generic dark modal with no focal point: the title, two competing boxes and a pile of explanatory text all sit at similar weight, and the buttons look disabled and have no visible pad focus.

12-mainframe-contracts.verdict: A full-bleed dark slab with a flat, monotone list: it is tidy but generic, with tiny type, a muddy amber focus row, and several style-guide violations (the $ sign, explaining sentences, a toast over a modal, and a top-left close that is not a close icon).

14-mainframe-racks.verdict: A flat, text-heavy dark form with placeholder profanity on screen, disabled buttons that read as dead rectangles, a collision in the header currency block, and nothing to draw the eye, so it is far below the polish bar.

16-bar-last-pour.verdict: A clean but generic dark modal with a mismatched centered title, two identical yellow buttons that flatten hierarchy, no visible pad focus, and a lot of dead space.

17-fashion-mirror.verdict: A competent dark-panel template with a clear two-column layout, but the grid is a wall of near-identical tiles, the operator preview is dwarfed, and the header, footer and list clip or crowd, so it reads as a debug inventory and not a Fortnite-grade fashion screen.

18-settings-hub.verdict: The new settings modal is cleaner: the half-clipped ghost row is gone and the detail text is larger, but it is still a long, dim, evenly weighted list with tiny tabs, a stranded value column and a mushy backdrop.

19-raid-hud-drop-first-raid.verdict: The raid HUD is functional but cluttered: five or six competing text panels, a keybind cheat sheet that stays open, duplicated tooltips and tiny dense type leave no clear focal point and no consistent panel language.

21-raid-hud-calm.verdict: The raid HUD is virtually unchanged: the contract list is reshuffled and one toast is gone, but it is still a pile of small, equally weighted, dim-on-busy-map panels with a dollar sign, a clipped label and no clear first read.

22-raid-map-open.verdict: The map is readable as a data dump, but labels collide with icons and with each other, the zone names are almost invisible, and the frame, header and HUD have no shared system, so it looks like a debug overlay rather than a polished AAA map.

23-raid-backpack-open.verdict: The backpack is a wide, mostly empty dark slab with tiny, low-contrast text and three lonely item slots, and it sits in a HUD cluttered with competing text blocks, so it looks like a debug panel rather than a AAA inventory.

25-raid-pause-box.verdict: The pause modal is a clean, well-aligned card with a clear amber primary, danger-outlined Abandon and a top-right X, but it is generic, the buttons are all the same width and weight, and the only change from the old version is slightly different text in the dimmed HUD behind it.

26-settings-from-pause-top.verdict: A clean, mostly on-guide settings card with sentence case, one tab strip and a top-right X, but the tab strip scrolls away inside the list, text is small, and the pad focus differs between the two captures.

32-keys-window.verdict: Clean, consistent keybind window that follows the guide's panel, close X and sentence-case rules, but it is a flat wall of identical key boxes with weak focus, a dim modal and nothing that says this is Pillagers.

33-raid-fight-alerts.verdict: The HUD works as a debug-style overlay but feels like a pile of mismatched panels: the minimap is clipped and overlaps a zone label, the contracts list is dense with tiny text, and the alert is duplicated three times.

35-kia-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card that mostly follows the shell (red title, one hero number, row of 4 stats, tile row, one primary), but the hero is a banned '$' figure, the secondary text is tiny and dim, and the item tiles are too small and confusingly placed above the number.

38-extracted-card.verdict: A clean, centred end card with a clear hero number and a single amber primary, but it's too crowded vertically, still uses '$' and several small explanatory lines, and its title, hero and chip rows compete.

40-whats-new-card.verdict: The What's new modal is now a centred card with a decent amber primary, but it is a wall of five run-on explaining paragraphs at one weight and size, while the world behind it leaks toasts, a hotbar and HUD that should be hidden or waiting.

45-arcade-attract-board.verdict: A bare black screen with a small 'Pillagers' wordmark, an empty-state leaderboard card and dim 'Press any button' text; it is tidy and on-palette but has no identity, no world backdrop and no focal point, and the card was only narrowed from 845px to 558px.

50-arcade-hud-live.verdict: A busy, mismatched HUD where tiny, low-contrast text sits on a noisy map, the bottom-right panel overlaps the world and its own props, and the corners disagree on type, size and panel style.

52-arcade-run-over.verdict: A clean, on-guide end card with a clear hero line and sentence case, but it ships as a bare stat slab with no real action button, a hero number smaller than spec, and nothing that makes a run-over moment feel like this game.
findings: P1 Footer action, bottom-right: Add a 56px primary 'Continue' (fill #f5b73b, ink #1a1205, min-width 200px) bottom-right and a ghost 'Back to menu' to its left. Drop the 'Press any button' line, or show it as a 28px key cap plus word in the bottom hint strip.

P1 Hero line 'Score 0 SP': Set the number at 56px f-cond 800 ('0') with 'SP' at 20px tx-2 beside it, and move 'Score' to a 16px label above. For a zero result, show a short state such as 'No score this run' in the title slot.
P1 Title 'Run over', top-left of the card: Set the title to 32px tx-1 (#efe9dc) 700. Keep the 36x2px amber tab. Remove the amber dot, or move amber to the primary button.

P1 Stats row (Kills, Extractions, Deaths): Use 4 equal columns of 24px values (f-cond 600) over 16px tx-2 labels, adding SP or Time. Brighten the labels to at least 4.5:1 (#aaa498 on #16191b). Reduce value weight to 600 so the hero wins.

P2 Card padding and vertical rhythm: Use 24px between the title and hero, 24px divider to stats, 32px stats to footer row, and a 72px footer row with the buttons vertically centred, so the bottom padding matches the top.

57-title-2p-coop-picked.verdict: The new title screen is cleaner (flat rows, no amber-on-everything, fixed 'Create a new save' casing, F1 and Settings added), but it is still a long, cluttered stack of explaining text and seven same-weight buttons with no clear primary action, and it runs to the bottom edge.

59-raid-abandon-confirm.verdict: A clean, compact confirm card with a clear title and a sensible primary/danger pair, but it has no close X or pad glyphs, a loose layout, a dim card edge, and a leftover HUD ghosting through the scrim.

65-codex.verdict: A legible but sparse card grid that fills only the top third of the screen, leaving a huge dead void, with a weak title, a jammed header, and no visible focus state.

66-trophy-case.verdict: The trophy cards are tidy individually, but the screen is two-thirds empty, the grid orphans a single card on row two, nothing shows focus, and the header stats and toast are crude.

62-arcade-operator-menu.verdict: A tidy, on-guide small dark card with a clear title, X and key hints, but it floats on a flat near-black void with a barely visible focus state and no primary action, so it reads as a generic template dialog.
findings: P1 Backdrop / whole screen: Bake the live scene or a dimmed arcade cabinet and attract frame at ~55% under --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80). Add a faint cabinet marquee or CRT motif so the screen feels like this game.

P1 Row list: New party / Exit demo: Focused row: --ui-raised fill, 3px --acc left bar plus 1px --acc border, text 20px tx-1. Make 'New party' the one 56px --acc fill button with --acc-ink text. Make 'Exit demo' a ghost with a 1px --ui-line-hi border, or a danger outline. Dim idle rows to ~70%.
P1 Subtitle 'Tonight: 0 runs': Set it to 16px f-cond 600 tx-2, on the title baseline, with a 16px gap to the first row. Drop it when the value is 0, or show 'No runs tonight' only if it matters.

P2 Footer key-hint strip: Set the labels to 16px tx-2 with a uniform 24px gap between groups, and use a 28px-high cap with a heavier arrow glyph. Show pad glyphs (A, B) when the last input was a pad. Keep Esc/B in one place.

P2 Header: title and close button: Use a 56px header row with the title (32px f-cond 700) and the 48x48 X vertically centred on it. Move the subtitle below with a 16px gap. Add the B glyph left of the X when on pad.

61-raid-wheel-open.verdict: The wheel itself has a clear gold focus segment, but it is buried under a controls cheat-sheet that overlaps it, a minimap and contracts list that clip, and a dozen competing HUD panels with inconsistent type and no shared panel style.

58-coop-player2-window-title.verdict: A centred, template-like title page that explains too much in small muted text, with a big amber title competing with the amber button, three stray amber headings, mixed sizes and a $ currency, so it fails the guide's hierarchy and clutter rules.
findings: P0 Whole screen: lore paragraph, 3-step columns, key-hint strip, 'First time out' line, saves hint line: Delete the lore paragraph, the three-step columns, the 'First time out' sentence and the 'Changing save reloads…' sentence. Keep the title, one primary button and a short saves list. Move the key hints to a bottom-edge legend at 16px and show them only in raid or on the controls screen.

P0 Title 'Pillagers' (about 56px amber gradient) vs 'Enter the undercroft' button: Make the title flat tx-1 at 56px (hero) and leave amber to the primary button. Put the button directly under the title with 24px gap, and add a tx-2 subtitle at 20px between them if one is needed.

P1 Primary button 'Enter the undercroft' (x681–1239, 56px high): Set width to 320–400px, centred. Put 'Player 2 window' as a tx-2 16px chip or in the header, not under the button. Keep the 24px gap above and below.
P1 Type system across the page: Snap every text to 56/32/20/16 only. Use tx-2 #aaa498 (4.5:1 minimum) for anything read. Raise the step descriptions and hint words to 16px minimum, or remove them.
P1 Step headings '1 · Ascend', '2 · Pillage', '3 · Extract': Remove the section entirely, or if kept, use tx-1 headings with no amber, constrain to the same 900px column and use --ui-line dividers.

46-arcade-attract-how-to-play.verdict: A clean, consistent control-reference card that follows the style guide's panel, caps and sentence-case rules, but it has no close X, a weak 'Press any button' prompt, tiny muted text and a cramped, unfinished feel for a first-impression screen.
findings: P1 Card header, top-right: Add a 48x48 ghost close button at the header's top-right (card x≈1330, y≈172-228) with a close glyph and 'B' / 'Esc' hints. Keep 'Press any button' as the footer hint.
P1 Footer 'Press any button' with amber ring: Make it a 56px primary button ('Got it', min-width 200px, fill #f5b73b, ink #1a1205) right-aligned in a 72px footer, and drop the radio-dot.

P1 Table rows (Move … Loot): Brighten row names to tx-1 at 20px. Group the rows into Combat (Move, Aim, Fire, Roll, Reload, Switch gun) and Raid (Items, Extract, Loot) with 16px gaps, or highlight Extract with a 3px accent bar. Tighten the label column to about 160px.

P1 Extract rows, 'in the ring' hints: Set the note to 16px tx-2, put it in the label column ('Extract (in the ring)'), and keep only the Hold X cap in the key columns. Or enlarge the circle to 28px to match the cap height.
P2 Key caps, Controller column: Render pad glyphs (round A/X buttons, trigger and bumper shapes) in the controller column, and make chips 28px high with 16px label type and 0 8px padding.

37-raid-extracting-countdown.verdict: The HUD is overloaded: a controls cheat-sheet, contracts list, scoreboard, pickup toasts, and a backpack panel all compete at once, with mismatched type sizes, overlapping labels, and no clear first read.

77-haul-reveal-done.verdict: The end card has a sound shell with a teal title, one amber primary and a centred stack, but it is overloaded with five text tiers, a '$' hero that breaks the SP rule, and body text that is too small for a couch.

63-arcade-operator-new-party-armed.verdict: A clean, on-token dark card with sentence case, a correct top-right close and a clear armed-danger state, but it is a small generic dialog on a flat black void, with weak hierarchy among its rows, small muted text and no pad-focus treatment.
findings: P1 Backdrop: Bake the live world behind the card, dimmed to ~55%, with a --scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) layer. The card and its border then separate from the background.

P1 Confirm new party / Exit demo rows: Make the armed row a 56px ghost with a 1px --danger border, tx-1 text and a faint fill (#1e2225). Keep red only for the border and a small label. Put Exit demo as a lower-weight ghost with a 16px gap, or move it to a footer left of the primary.
P1 Helper line 'Clears tonight's best · New seed': Remove it, or fold it into the armed row as a 16px tx-2 right-aligned value ('Clears best, new seed'). Floor it at 16px and 4.5:1.
P2 Header: 'Operator' + 'Tonight: 0 runs': Set the subline to 20px tx-2 on the title baseline, as '0 runs tonight' in the muted count style, or drop it. Keep 16px minimum.
P2 Key hint strip: Use 16px tx-2 labels with 28px-high caps and equal 24px gaps. Swap in pad glyphs (A/B/D-pad) when the last input was a pad. Right-align the strip or place it on the bottom edge.

55-arcade-run-over-scored.verdict: A clean, on-guide dark card with sentence case and a clear Score 0 SP hero, but it is small and sparse in the middle of a muddy blurred backdrop, with a weak title, three stats instead of four, and no real button or close control.
findings: P1 Footer 'Press any button' with radio-dot glyph: Add a 56px high, min 200px wide --acc primary ('Continue') at bottom-right, with a 'Back' ghost to its left. Use the real pad glyph (A) beside the label. Keep the footer row at 72px.

P1 Hero line 'Score 0 SP': Set the number alone at 56px f-cond 800 ('0 SP') with a 'Score' label in 16px tx-2 above it. For a zero run, show a fitting hero or a line such as 'No haul' in the same slot.
P1 Title 'Run over' and top accent tab: Set the title to 32px f-cond 700 in tx-1. Keep the 36px amber tab, and keep the title/hero gap at 16px.
P2 Stats row (Kills, Extractions, Deaths): Add a fourth stat such as 'Time' or 'Loot' so the columns span 652px (4 × 163px). Set labels to 16px and values to 24px.

P2 Card size and layout: Use 24px padding on an 8px grid, make the gap between stats and footer 24px, and let the card height follow its content. Bring the hero up toward the 56px size so the card fills out.

60-abandoned-card.verdict: The abandoned card now follows the shared end-card shell and finally has a hero number, but it is still small and timid, with a sub-minimum XP line, a leftover "$" and no close X or pad glyphs, so it falls short of ARC Raiders polish.

42-hub-pause-box.verdict: The pause card is now clean and reads in one pass: a single amber primary, ghost buttons and a danger-bordered exit. It is still cramped at the top and bottom, with a toast under the modal and no close button or pad hints, so it falls short of the style guide.

49-arcade-pause-box.verdict: The pause card is now clean: a plain 4px-radius frame, a ghost X, a clear amber Resume and a separated danger action. It still has the unstyled 'Esc Resume' hint, no visible pad focus state, and a card that is small and sparse at couch distance.
findings: P1 Footer hint 'Esc Resume' (bottom right): Draw a 28px-high cap with a 1px --ui-line-hi border around 'Esc' and set 'Resume' at 16px f-cond 600 tx-2 beside it. Swap to the B or Start glyph when the pad is active. Or delete the hint, since the X already shows close, and cut the card height by about 48px.

P1 Button stack focus state: Focused ghost row: 2px --acc border, --ui-raised fill and a 3px left --acc bar. Show a screenshot with focus on Settings and another on End run, where the focus border should be --danger.
P1 Card scale at 1080p: Set button text to 20px f-cond 700 and the title to 32px. Raise the buttons to 56px (they are about 56 now, so keep that) and widen the card to 520px.
P2 Backdrop: Use rgba(6,7,8,.80) over a baked world at 55%, and hide the 'How to play' overlay and the HUD while the pause card is open.
P2 End run group spacing and colour: Lighten the danger text to about #ef5a42 to reach at least 4.5:1, and keep the 1px --danger border.

56-arcade-attract-board-scored.verdict: The backdrop is now blurred and dimmed, but the card still lists five empty placeholder rows, the 'Press any button' prompt is still small and tucked in the corner, and the wordmark is still plain text, so the screen reads as an empty template.
findings: P1 Score rows 1-5 (1. --- / --): Delete the 5 rows. Show one centred 'No scores yet' at 20px f-cond 600 in tx-2 #aaa498. Shrink the card to about 480x240. Keep rows only when real scores exist; then rank 1 is tx-1 at 20px and the other ranks are at least 4.5:1.

P1 'Press any button' prompt, bottom-right of card: Centre it under the content as a 56px-high primary prompt (min-width 200px, --acc fill, --acc-ink text 20px 700). Alternatively use 32px f-cond 700 tx-1 with a 28px pad 'A' glyph chip (1px --ui-line-hi) before the word.
P1 Hierarchy of the card: Keep the title as the only bold text. Make 'No scores yet' 20px, weight 600, tx-2. Make the press prompt the second-strongest element (amber fill or 32px tx-1).

P1 'Pillagers' wordmark, top-left at (95,72): Replace it with a real logo lockup (about 160x48) at the 5% margin, or put a 56px hero title above the card and delete the corner text. Keep only one of the two.
P2 Card shell, 558x500 at (681,290): Size the card to its content (480x240 for the empty state). Use 24px padding on all sides and keep the 36px accent tab.

47-arcade-drop-controls-card.verdict: The How to play card is a clean, readable table, but it sits on top of a fully live HUD with duplicate storm toasts, a clipped player label and an unmoved currency block, so the screen reads as cluttered and off-guide.
findings: P0 Whole screen: controls card over live HUD: Dim the world with the scrim rgba(6,7,8,.80) and hide the HUD while the card is open. Centre the card (max 960x680) with a 56px header, a close X at top-right, and a 72px footer holding a 56px primary 'Got it' button.
P0 Storm toasts at (960,165) and (180,783): Show one toast only: top-centre, 40px high, 4px left accent bar, --fs-label, 3s. Suppress it while the controls card is open.
P1 Player label at (960,350): Draw the label above the HUD and world occlusion with a 1px panel backing, in tx-1. Move it 24px above the player so it clears the wall, and drop the teal.

P1 Controls card (40-487, 162-732): Add a 48x48 ghost X at the header's top-right plus 'B' and 'Esc' key caps. Set the title to 32px f-cond 700. Add a footer with a 56px primary 'Got it' button at the bottom-right. Centre the card.

P1 Table rows and key caps: Raise the headers to 16px tx-2 at 600 weight, then set the row dividers to --ui-line (#2e3337) at a visible 1px. Replace the rings with a single 'hold' glyph, or drop them. Set cap text to 18-20px on a 28px cap.

48-arcade-hud-move-to-start.verdict: The in-raid HUD works as a functional tutorial overlay but looks like stacked, unrelated widgets: the controls panel buries the start prompt, and six different type sizes, mixed panel styles, and washed-out low-contrast text break the guide.
findings: P0 Whole screen hierarchy: How to play panel vs the 'Shield - Move to start' prompt: Shrink the panel to a 4-row essentials list or collapse it to a dismissible strip. Promote the start prompt to a 32px tx-1 centred line with a key cap ('WASD  Move to start'). Make the panel 70% opacity so the world and the prompt read first.

P1 Top-centre score block (Score / 0 SP / 9:46 / Extract 140m): Sit the block 24px below the top edge, SP at 56px f-cond 800 tx-1, timer 20px tx-1, extract line 16px --extract on a 40px --ui-panel 90% chip. Drop the 'Score' label or move it to 16px tx-2.

P1 Bottom-left status stack (Standing, Armour 60, Stamina, HP 100): One bar component: 12px high, 320px wide, 8px gap, 16px tx-1 label left-aligned above or inside each bar. HP gets the only heavy treatment (24px number). Drop the 'Standing' tab or make it a 16px chip. Move the stack to the 5% margin.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel ('B / I backpack', Burst Carbine 24 / 144, 4 items $390): Use a 1px --ui-line-hi bordered panel with 24px padding, inset 5% from the edges. Ammo is the hero at 56px, weapon name 20px tx-2. Make the hint a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack'). Replace '$390' with 'Credits 390' or remove it.

P1 Run Info / Run goals panel (right, under the minimap): Merge to one 16px tx-2 label, 'Run goals'. Rows at 16px tx-1 with right-aligned SP values in tx-2, 8px gaps, 16px padding, 1px --ui-line-hi border and --ui-panel fill. Leave a 16px gap below the minimap.

53-arcade-extracted-bonus-initials.verdict: The shot, named 'extracted bonus initials', shows an in-raid HUD mid-extract with no end card or initials entry, and the same extract message is repeated four times while the corner panels, type sizes and credit/stash lines break the style guide.
findings: P0 Whole screen vs. filename (extracted / bonus / initials): Capture the end card: hide the HUD, put a 720px centred card on rgba(6,7,8,.80), title 32px --extract, one 56px hero line for SP, a 4-stat row, then initials tiles and one 56px primary button.

P0 Top-centre banner, centre 'Hold [X] to extract', bottom 'Extract in progress! C 28S left', left toast stack: Keep one 40px toast or one centre prompt. Delete the banner, the bottom text and the toast duplicate. Show a single countdown at 56px --extract. Fix the string to '28 s left'.

P1 Top-centre cluster: Score 0 SP / 9:51 / Extraction 0m / arrow: One hero value at 56px f-cond 800 (the timer during extract, otherwise SP). Put the 'Score' label in tx-2 at 16px. Remove 'Extraction 0m' and the loose arrow, or fold them into the one extract bar. Keep everything inside a 5% margin.

P1 Top-right currency block and 'Stash 0 bag 390': One row, 'Credits 900 · XP 0', at 20px with an icon, on a --ui-panel 90% backing. Remove the stash line or move it to the lobby. Replace '$390' with an SP value or delete it. Leave 16px between the block and the minimap.

P1 Run Info panel (right) and left toast stack: Panel P: --ui-panel, 1px --ui-line-hi, 4px radius, 24px padding. One title in tx-1 at 20px. Rows at 16px minimum with 8px gaps and values right-aligned in tx-2. Cap toasts at 3, 40px high, and delete the tip sentences. Raise the Storm line to 4.5:1 contrast or remove it.

54-arcade-initials-redrop.verdict: The HUD works as an in-raid overlay, but the same extraction event appears four times, the top-centre block is cramped and overlaps, and type sizes, tags and panel styles ignore the guide.
findings: P0 Extraction messaging (centre banner, top toast, left feed, bottom line): Keep one: a 56px hero countdown in --extract at top-centre ('25 s'), plus a 40px toast at most. Delete the left-feed copy, the bottom line and the 'Extraction 0m' label. Make the 25 s the only big number.

P0 Top-centre block: Score / 0 SP / 9:48 / Extraction 0m / arrow / '?' / toast / 'Warden' label: Move the toast to its own slot at y≈96 with 40px height and no overlap. Push the block in from the top by at least 24px. Drop the '?' and the arrow, or put them in the world. Raise the 'Score' label to 16px.

P1 Bottom-centre text: 'Extract in progress! C 25S left', '19 hostiles closing in': Write '25 s'. Remove the 'C'. Put the line on a 40px toast with a 4px danger bar, or drop it. Keep 16px of clear space above the hotbar tag.

P1 Bottom-left feed (Stronghold, Golden enemy, Spotted, Extract): Show at most 3 toasts, each 40px high with a 4px left bar. Use tx-1 text at 16px minimum and a --scrim fill. Remove info toasts that repeat the map state. Hide the grey ones after 3 s.

P1 Bottom-right ammo panel: Make the ammo 56px f-cond 800 and the weapon name 20px tx-2. Change the key hint to a cap plus a word ('B  Backpack') at 16px in a footer. Replace '$390' with 'SP 390' or remove it. Shrink the panel to fit its content, with 24px padding.

64-arcade-board-seeded-night.verdict: A clean, on-palette modal that obeys the sentence-case and panel rules, but it is an empty leaderboard of dashes with undersized, low-contrast text, no close control and no primary button, so it reads as a placeholder rather than a polished screen.
findings: P0 Whole card body, rows 1-5: Remove the five dummy rows. Show one centred empty state: 'No scores yet' in tx-1 20px, plus a single 16px tx-2 line only if it is needed. Or collapse the card to roughly 480x240 per the card-dialog spec. A modal must never exceed its content.

P1 Card header (x713-884, y320): Add a 48x48 ghost close button at the top-right of the header (x~1180-1228) with the B glyph. Replace 'Press any button' with a 56px ghost 'Back' or primary 'Close' button in the 72px footer, plus a 'B  Back' key-hint cap.

P1 Subtitle 'Seeded night · CBT2' (y373) and row text: Set the subtitle to 16px f-cond 600 in tx-2 (#aaa498 or brighter). Put it on the same baseline as the title as a muted count, or directly beneath it. Raise the row numbers to 20px and tx-2. Never go dimmer than #aaa498 on #16191b.

P1 'Press any button' prompt (x1040-1206, y750): Use the real pad glyph (A/B) in a 28px chip with a word ('A  Close'). Or make it a 56px high, 200px minimum ghost button with a visible focus border in --acc, right-aligned in a 72px footer.
P2 Card padding and vertical spacing: Lock the rhythm to the 8px grid: 24px padding, 56px header, rows at a 56px pitch, 72px footer. Remove the extra empty rows to cut the card height to about 360px.

70-settings-sec-controls.verdict: The new settings card is shorter, so it shows only 6 rows before the fade-out cut (the old one showed about 9). It trades usable content for centering, and it keeps the same weak hierarchy, a stray footer warning, and undersized type.

76-haul-reveal-mid.verdict: The Extracted card follows the shell (teal title, dark panel, amber primary) but it is a stack of seven equal-weight centred bands, with a '$' hero that breaks the SP rule, a stray floating tile, and too many small text lines.

75-settings-pad-rebind-waiting.verdict: The banner text is now bigger and shorter, and the clipped 'Gear' rows no longer peek out, but the modal is still a cramped scrolling list with wrapped labels, collided rows, and a sub-spec type scale.

72-settings-sec-display.verdict: A clean, consistent dark settings modal with a clear amber focus row and one tab strip, but the stepper values sit far from their labels, a row is clipped at the list bottom, and the small type and tiny chevrons would be hard to read from a couch.

74-settings-change-pad-buttons.verdict: The new version dims the backdrop and adds a fade at the scroll edge and an 'Esc Close' hint, but the cramped three-line wrapped label, the clipped fade row and the loose 'Esc Close' hint keep it at an amateur 2, and no pad focus is visible.
